cues.en: Presenter: In this video, I'm going to make another distinction between two different kinds of data, and that is sample data versus population data.
cues.zh: 這部影片，要再區分兩種不同資料，也就是樣本資料與母體資料。

cues.en: So let's see what those two mean.
cues.zh: 看看兩者是什麼意思。

cues.en: I'm gonna start with definitions and then I will give some examples.
cues.zh: 先給定義，再舉例。

cues.en: So you have an idea of what the distinction is between population data and sample data.
cues.zh: 讓你了解母體資料與樣本資料的區別。

cues.en: So population data means you are getting data from all of the members of a group.
cues.zh: 母體資料，代表取得一個群體所有成員的資料。

cues.en: So from every single individual of the group that you are investigating, you have data from every single member.
cues.zh: 也就是研究的群體中，每個個體、每位成員，都有資料。

cues.en: In contrast, sample data is when you have data only from some of the members of a group, but not every single member of the group.
cues.zh: 相對地，樣本資料，是只有群體中部分成員的資料，而非每一位。

cues.en: Now, hopefully, if you've designed your experiment well, these are randomly selected data and that basically means that the sample is representative of the population.
cues.zh: 如果實驗設計良好，希望這些資料是隨機選出的，基本上代表樣本能代表母體。

cues.en: I will talk more about why that's important and what the implications are of non-random selections later in the course.
cues.zh: 稍後會再談，為什麼這很重要，以及非隨機選取有什麼影響。

cues.en: I think it's probably in the section about hypothesis testing, but basically, you should hope you should design your experiments such that these sample data
cues.zh: 我想大概在假設檢定那一節。不過基本上，應該希望、也應該把實驗設計成，這些樣本資料，

cues.en: are randomly selected from the population and that allows you to generalize from your sample data to your population data.
cues.zh: 從母體隨機選出，這才能由樣本資料推廣到母體資料。

cues.en: Okay, so let's go through some quick examples.
cues.zh: 快速看幾個例子。

cues.en: So population data might be if we are interested in the salaries of all the people who work in one particular department.
cues.zh: 母體資料可能是，我們想知道某個特定部門所有人的薪資。

cues.en: Now, most departments at most companies or universities or whatever, departments tend to be relatively small.
cues.zh: 大多數公司、大學等機構的部門，通常規模相對小。

cues.en: Maybe there's a handful of people or a few dozen people.
cues.zh: 可能只有幾個人，或幾十個人。

cues.en: Even if there's a couple 100 people who work in one department, that is a reasonable number of individuals that we can measure the salary
cues.zh: 即使一個部門有幾百人，也算合理數量，可以測量，

cues.en: from every single person in that department.
cues.zh: 部門中每一個人的薪資。

cues.en: So that's really a population.
cues.zh: 所以這確實是母體。

cues.en: Likewise, the number of lions in a particular zoo is a population, so that's the population of lions at that zoo, and that's also a small number.
cues.zh: 同樣，某座動物園的獅子數量，就是母體，也就是那座動物園的獅子母體，數量也很小。

cues.en: So it's easy for us to gather population data for this particular population.
cues.zh: 所以很容易蒐集這個特定母體的母體資料。

cues.en: Same goes for Facebook group members.
cues.zh: Facebook 社團成員也一樣。

cues.en: We can gather data from every single member of that population, and I'm sure Facebook does gather all that data.
cues.zh: 可以蒐集這個母體中，每個成員的資料，我相信 Facebook 確實蒐集了全部資料。

cues.en: Now, let's think about sample data.
cues.zh: 現在想想樣本資料。

cues.en: So let's say we wanted to know the average height of Italian people.
cues.zh: 假設想知道義大利人的平均身高。

cues.en: Well, there is a population of Italian people, I don't know how many Italians there are.
cues.zh: 有一個義大利人的母體，我不知道有多少義大利人。

cues.en: It must be millions, many millions, but it's not really feasible to measure the height of every single Italian.
cues.zh: 一定有幾百萬、很多百萬人，但測量每一位義大利人的身高，實在不可行。

cues.en: So instead, what we would do is sample from the entire population of some number of Italians.
cues.zh: 所以改從整個母體，抽取一定數量的義大利人。

cues.en: So that's gonna give us the average height and we're just gonna get sample data because we are not measuring, we're not getting a data set from the entire population.
cues.zh: 這會給出平均身高，但只能得到樣本資料，因為沒有測量、取得整個母體的資料集。

cues.en: Likewise, So here, this was salaries in a specific department.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡是特定部門的薪資。

cues.en: Now I'm talking about salaries of teachers.
cues.zh: 現在改談教師薪資。

cues.en: Maybe this is, you know, all the teachers in Canada or something.
cues.zh: 也許是加拿大所有教師之類。

cues.en: So there is a population, but we are not going to be gathering data from the entire population because it's just, it's too many, it's not really feasible.
cues.zh: 確實有母體，但不會蒐集整個母體的資料，因為人太多，實在不可行。

cues.en: So this would be sample data. And here's the last example.
cues.zh: 所以這會是樣本資料。最後一個例子。

cues.en: There is some finite number of stars in the Milky Way galaxy.
cues.zh: 銀河系有某個有限數量的恆星。

cues.en: I don't know what it is. Probably some huge number, more than the number of Italians.
cues.zh: 我不知道多少，大概是很大的數，比義大利人的數量還多。

cues.en: So, you know, you could give every Italian person their own star in the Milky Way galaxy and there would be plenty of stars left over, but it's not really feasible or even sensible to measure the brightness
cues.zh: 所以可以給每位義大利人一顆自己的銀河系恆星，還剩下很多。但測量每一顆恆星的亮度，

cues.en: of every single star.
cues.zh: 並不真正可行，也未必合理。

cues.en: Instead, we can just sample from all the stars and assuming it's a random sample that's going to tell us about the distribution of brightness of stars in the Milky Way.
cues.zh: 可以從所有恆星中抽樣，假設是隨機樣本，就能告訴我們銀河系恆星亮度的分布。

cues.en: Alright, so I hope that the definitions and these examples make sense.
cues.zh: 希望定義與例子都清楚。

cues.en: What I would like you to do now is pause the video and go through each of these four descriptions and decide whether you think this refers
cues.zh: 現在請暫停影片，逐一看這四個描述，判斷你認為它指的是，

cues.en: to population data or sample data.
cues.zh: 母體資料，還是樣本資料。

cues.en: So each one, whether each one is referring to population data or sample data.
cues.zh: 每一個，分別是指母體資料，還是樣本資料。

cues.en: Alright, have you paused the video?
cues.zh: 有暫停影片嗎？

cues.en: Did you figure this out?
cues.zh: 想出答案了嗎？

cues.en: Well, I'm gonna call this first one sample data because there's lots and lots of Dutch people, we don't really, it's not feasible to measure every single Dutch person just to ask them
cues.zh: 第一個我會稱為樣本資料，因為荷蘭人非常多，不太可能只為了詢問寵物數量，

cues.en: how many pets they have.
cues.zh: 就測量每一位荷蘭人。

cues.en: So we're gonna gather sample data here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會蒐集樣本資料。

cues.en: Now, here's a question or this example I think could go either way.
cues.zh: 這題、這個例子，我認為兩者都有可能。

cues.en: I actually called this one population data and that's because I'm assuming that the University of X, so there's no university called X, but this is just, you know, a placeholder
cues.zh: 我把它稱為母體資料，因為假設 X 大學，並不是真的有一所叫 X 的大學，只是代稱，

cues.en: for a specific university.
cues.zh: 某一所特定大學。

cues.en: Sophomores means that it's second years.
cues.zh: Sophomores 代表大二學生。

cues.en: So the number of Udemy courses completed by second year students at a particular university.
cues.zh: 所以是某所特定大學，大二學生完成的 Udemy 課程數量。

cues.en: Maybe this is a small university and there's only, let's say 1002nd year students there.
cues.zh: 也許這是間小大學，假設只有 1,000 位大二學生。

cues.en: So it actually is feasible for us to gather data from the entire population.
cues.zh: 那麼蒐集整個母體的資料，其實可行。

cues.en: So this could be population data.
cues.zh: 所以這可能是母體資料。

cues.en: Notice that sample data here wouldn't be wrong.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡說樣本資料也不算錯。

cues.en: We could gather sample data here.
cues.zh: 也可以蒐集樣本資料。

cues.en: So in some cases, whether these are population or sample data kind of depends on how you are setting up your experiment, how easy it is
cues.zh: 有些情況下，資料屬於母體或樣本，取決於如何設計實驗，以及，

cues.en: to collect data and so on.
cues.zh: 蒐集資料有多容易等因素。

cues.en: And that's why I brought up this example as well.
cues.zh: 這也是我提出這個例子的原因。

cues.en: So the number of people who voted in Lichtenstein in 2020, well it turns out as of me filming this video,
cues.zh: 接著，2020 年列支敦斯登的投票人數。截至錄製這部影片時，

cues.en: there are 38,557 people in Lichtenstein.
cues.zh: 列支敦斯登有 38,557 人。

cues.en: According to, where am I getting this?
cues.zh: 根據哪裡呢？我的資料從哪裡來？

cues.en: According to Google, I'm not sure where Google is getting that information from.
cues.zh: 根據 Google，我不確定 Google 又是從哪裡取得這項資訊。

cues.en: So 38,000 people, I think that is feasible to gather population data here.
cues.zh: 所以 38,000 人，我認為蒐集母體資料是可行的。

cues.en: Now here, we have the opinion of Chinese people about the mountains in Grenoble.
cues.zh: 這裡是中國人對 Grenoble 群山的看法。

cues.en: Now first of all, I don't know why you would need to do research about this.
cues.zh: 首先，我不知道為什麼需要研究這個。

cues.en: No one can dislike the mountains of Grenoble, they're beautiful.
cues.zh: 不可能有人不喜歡 Grenoble 的山，它們很美。

cues.en: But if we wanted to measure the opinion of Chinese people about these particular mountains, it's not really feasible to measure every single Chinese to, you know,
cues.zh: 但如果想測量中國人對這些山的看法，不可能測量每一位中國人，

cues.en: to ask every single Chinese person what they think about these mountains.
cues.zh: 逐一詢問他們對這些山有什麼看法。

cues.en: So we would just take some sample data.
cues.zh: 所以只會抽取一些樣本資料。

cues.en: Alright, two more examples, and I wanna use this to highlight the ambiguity.
cues.zh: 再看兩個例子，用來凸顯歧義。

cues.en: Sometimes, it's ambiguous whether we want population data or sample data.
cues.zh: 有時，我們想要母體資料或樣本資料，是模糊的。

cues.en: So taking a census of a country or voting in a national election.
cues.zh: 例如一個國家的人口普查，或全國性選舉投票。

cues.en: So what do you guys think about this one or these two?
cues.zh: 你們覺得這兩個例子如何？

cues.en: So I said that this is population data because in fact, that's the whole point of a census.
cues.zh: 我說這是母體資料，因為那就是人口普查的目的。

cues.en: The purpose of a census is to measure every single person in a country and to know something about them, their age, and their income.
cues.zh: 人口普查是要測量國家的每個人，了解他們的年齡、收入。

cues.en: And I don't actually know what these censuses measure, but it's supposed to be measuring population data.
cues.zh: 我其實不知道普查還測什麼，但它應該測量的是母體資料。

cues.en: Now, voting in a national election is, could be open to opinion.
cues.zh: 全國性選舉投票，則可能見仁見智。

cues.en: Actually, I would say voting in a national election is ideally a population.
cues.zh: 我會說，理想上，全國性選舉投票應該是母體。

cues.en: It should be ideally in my opinion, that every single person in a country who is of voting age votes in a national election.
cues.zh: 在我看來，理想上，每一位達到投票年齡的國民，都應該在全國性選舉投票。

cues.en: But of course, in practice, that doesn't really happen even in countries where there is obligatory voting.
cues.zh: 但實務上當然不是如此，即使是強制投票的國家。

cues.en: Like in Australia for example, it's still not the case that every single person of voting age votes in the election.
cues.zh: 例如澳洲，仍不是每位達到投票年齡的人，都在選舉投票。

cues.en: So in practice, voting ends up just being a sample.
cues.zh: 所以實際上，投票最後只是樣本。

cues.en: Now, of course, it's a super important question whether that sample of people that votes is a representative sample of the larger population.
cues.zh: 當然，這群投票者的樣本，是否能代表更大的母體，是非常重要的問題。

cues.en: That's obviously well outside the scope of this course, but just to give you a sense of these two terms and what they mean and how they relate to each other.
cues.zh: 這顯然遠超出本課程範圍，只是讓你了解這兩個術語的意義，以及彼此關係。

cues.en: Okay, so I hope you can see first of all the difference between population data and sample data.
cues.zh: 希望你先看出母體資料與樣本資料的差別。

cues.en: Essentially, population data is data from every member of the group you're interested in.
cues.zh: 基本上，母體資料來自你關心群體的每位成員。

cues.en: Sample data is data from only a subset of the members of the group that you're interested in.
cues.zh: 樣本資料，只來自你關心群體中的部分成員。

cues.en: The notations for describing for the parameters that describe population sample are also sometimes a little bit different, but not always.
cues.zh: 用來描述母體、樣本參數的記號，有時也稍微不同，但並非總是如此。

cues.en: So for population parameters, we often use these lowercase Greek symbols like mu for the mean, beta, this would be for a regression coefficient
cues.zh: 母體參數，常使用這些希臘小寫字母，例如用 μ 表示平均值，β 表示迴歸係數，

cues.en: and sigma squared for the variance.
cues.zh: σ 平方表示變異數。

cues.en: If you don't know what these terms mean that I'm referring to here, mean, regression coefficient, variance, don't worry, you will learn all about those later in the course.
cues.zh: 如果不知道這些術語，也就是平均值、迴歸係數、變異數的意思，不用擔心，稍後課程都會學到。

cues.en: So these would be the population parameters.
cues.zh: 這些是母體參數。

cues.en: And then for sample, some people would use the same Greek lowercase characters, but with this carrot symbol on top of them.
cues.zh: 樣本方面，有些人也用相同的希臘小寫字母，但上方多這個尖角符號。

cues.en: So this little angled hat symbol.
cues.zh: 就是這個小小的帽子符號。

cues.en: But as I've mentioned before and we'll probably complain about again later in the course, throughout this course, not everyone uses exactly
cues.zh: 不過，先前提過，之後大概還會再抱怨，課程中不是每個人都對同一概念使用，

cues.en: the same terminology for the same concept.
cues.zh: 完全相同的術語。

cues.en: So you'll also often see sample estimates to be something like X bar.
cues.zh: 所以也常看到樣本估計寫成 x bar。

cues.en: So with a line on top or S squared for sigma.
cues.zh: 上面有一條線，或用 s 平方對應 σ。

cues.en: But sometimes, also people will use sigma to indicate a sample estimate.
cues.zh: 但有時，也有人用 σ 表示樣本估計。

cues.en: Even though here I'm saying that sigma is a population parameter.
cues.zh: 即使我這裡說，σ 是母體參數。

cues.en: Same thing with the beta coefficient here, which would be, you know, some, you can use this either for sample or for population.
cues.zh: β 係數也一樣，可以用於樣本，也可以用於母體。

cues.en: Unfortunately, we just have to live with this ambiguity and sometimes, or hopefully, nearly always, it's obvious from context whether we are referring
cues.zh: 很不幸，只能接受這種歧義。有時，或希望幾乎總是，能從上下文清楚看出，我們指的是，

cues.en: to a population or a sample parameter.
cues.zh: 母體參數，還是樣本參數。

cues.en: Okay, so who cares?
cues.zh: 誰在乎呢？

cues.en: Does it really matter whether we are calling these things sample or population?
cues.zh: 把它們叫做樣本或母體，真的重要嗎？

cues.en: The thing is that many statistical procedures are designed either for sample data or for population data.
cues.zh: 許多統計程序，是專為樣本資料，或專為母體資料設計。

cues.en: And so applying the wrong procedure to the wrong data type can lead to incorrect results and incorrect, slightly incorrect interpretations.
cues.zh: 所以，把錯的程序用在錯的資料類型，可能得到錯誤結果，以及不正確，或稍微不正確的解讀。

cues.en: Now, that I see this text with an exclamation point, it sounds very dramatic and really horrible, but in practice, it doesn't tend to matter so much.
cues.zh: 現在看到文字後面有驚嘆號，好像非常戲劇化、很可怕，但實務上，通常影響沒有那麼大。

cues.en: You'll see examples of this later with, for example, degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 之後會看到例子，例如自由度。

cues.en: If you get the degrees of freedom wrong for sample data versus population data, as long as you have a reasonable sample size,
cues.zh: 如果對樣本與母體資料，用錯自由度，只要樣本數合理，

cues.en: let's say more than 30 samples, it doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 例如超過 30 個樣本，影響其實不大。

cues.en: You're not gonna come to a wildly different conclusion about the statistical result except maybe in certain cases for relatively small sample sizes.
cues.zh: 不會對統計結果得到天差地遠的結論，除非某些情況下，樣本數相對很小。

cues.en: But this is important to think about sample versus population.
cues.zh: 但思考樣本與母體，仍然很重要。

cues.en: The good news is that nearly all the time in statistics, you are working with sample data and not with population data.
cues.zh: 好消息是，統計中幾乎所有時候，處理的都是樣本資料，而非母體資料。

cues.en: And that's generally the case because usually, we are interested in generalizing our results to a large population, but it's infeasible to measure
cues.zh: 通常如此，是因為想把結果推廣到大型母體，但測量，

cues.en: from that really large population.
cues.zh: 那個非常大的母體並不可行。

cues.en: So nearly all the time, we are working with sample data.
cues.zh: 所以幾乎總是處理樣本資料。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video, you learned about the difference between sample data and population data.
cues.zh: 這部影片，你學到樣本資料與母體資料的差別。

cues.en: I showed you several examples and I also explained that sometimes, it can be a little bit ambiguous, whether the data in question referred to samples or the entire population.
cues.zh: 我展示了幾個例子，也解釋有時可能稍有歧義：某些資料究竟代表樣本，還是整個母體。
